💡 How to Connect Student Website Submissions (Manual Workflow Guide)
Toggle Setup Guide
1 Receive Archive

Receive student's website submission file (e.g. student.zip).

2 Extract Files

Unzip file contents on your local computer.

3 Copy Assets

Place files inside submissions/{rollNumber}/ (e.g. submissions/52/).

4 Verify index.html

Ensure main entry file is named index.html.

5 Save Record

Click ➕ Add Student or Edit and check Website Submitted.
